title: MCP list_skills Response
description: Serving-integrity contract U11/R15: `tools/mcp_server.py`'s `list_skills` tool response, built by `_serialize_skills`. U7/R3: the mapped skills for a (country, curriculum, grade) scope, optionally narrowed to one unit_code, each carrying its curriculum-local presentation straight off the mapping row (orchestrator/catalog.py's SkillsResult). An unmatched scope or unit_code returns skills=[], never an error (plan point 6). U14: each skill also carries `servable`, checked against `bank_version`'s build (`orchestrator/serving.py`'s `ServingFacade.list_skills`) — the positive-polarity counterpart of `recommendation-result.schema.json`'s `unservable`; the catalog answers 'what can I bind to' rather than 'what got flagged', so the two fields are deliberately opposite in sense, not just in name.

unit_code.description: The narrowing filter this result was built with, echoed back verbatim; null when the call didn't narrow to one unit.

bank_version.description: The bank build every skill's `servable` was checked against (U14). Null when no bank could be resolved or loaded (no ACTIVE pointer configured, or the resolved build failed to load) — in that case every skill is `servable: false`, but the catalog itself still answers rather than erroring (KD3).

terminology_overrides.description: Curriculum-local term substitutions, keyed by the canonical term they replace.

servable.description: True when the bank build named by this response's bank_version holds at least one instance for this skill (U14) — never used to drop a skill from the list, only to annotate it.
